title: Cognizant GenC style · Aptitude
description: Quant, logical and English, 25 each, like the GenC assessment. 75 MCQs in 95 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 7:5. After 10 years, the ratio will be 19:15. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 7x and 5x. (7x+10)/(5x+10) = 19/15 gives x = 4; A = 28.

questions.text: The price of an item is first increased by 25% and then decreased by 25%. What is the net percentage change in its price?
questions.explanation: Net factor = (1 + 25/100)(1 - 25/100) = 15/16, so the change is -25/4%: a 25/4% decrease.

Remote work was once rare in Indian companies. The pandemic forced firms to try it at scale, and many found that productivity did not fall. Employees saved hours of commuting, and companies saved on office space. However, new problems appeared: junior staff missed informal learning from seniors, and some people found it hard to separate work from home life. Many firms have now settled on a hybrid model, with two or three office days a week.

Fill in the blank: The police ____ arrested the thief.
questions.explanation: Correct: The police have arrested the thief.

Read the passage and answer.

Good sleep is essential for learning. While we sleep, the brain sorts and stores what we learned during the day. Students who stay up all night before an exam often remember less than those who sleep well, even if they studied for more hours. Regular sleep times, less screen use before bed and a dark, quiet room all improve sleep quality.

What does the brain do during sleep, according to the passage?
options: Sorts and stores what was learned
questions.explanation: The passage supports: Sorts and stores what was learned.

Read the passage and answer.

Many rivers in India are fed by Himalayan glaciers. As temperatures rise, these glaciers are shrinking. In the short term this can increase river flow and the risk of floods; in the long term, rivers may carry less water in dry months. Scientists stress the need to monitor glaciers and to plan water use carefully.

Scientists stress the need to
options: monitor glaciers and plan water use
questions.explanation: The passage supports: monitor glaciers and plan water use.

Plastic is cheap, light and durable, which is why it is everywhere. The same durability makes it a problem: most plastic takes hundreds of years to break down. Much of it ends up in rivers and oceans, where it harms animals that swallow it or get trapped. Recycling helps, but only a small share of plastic is actually recycled. Experts say the most effective step is to use less plastic in the first place.

The word ‘durable’ in the passage means
Fill in the blank: She has been working here ____ 2019.

Open-source software is written by communities and shared freely. Anyone can read the code, suggest changes or report bugs. Because many people review it, problems are often found quickly. Companies use open-source tools to save costs and avoid being locked to one vendor, and many pay their engineers to contribute back.
